capabilities: Sync EPUB highlights and notes into Markdown
Sync PDF annotations with rendered PDF page images
Split heavily annotated books into chapter notes
Create a Bases view for browsing synced book notes
Run sync, plan, and doctor commands via the absync CLI for automation
extras: Desktop-only; mobile Obsidian is not supported. Requires macOS. The absync CLI must be installed separately and needs vault-scoped plugin settings, so it cannot run without the plugin enabled.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull highlights, notes, and PDF annotations out of Apple Books into vault notes.

relations.evidence: syncs Apple Books highlights, notes, and PDF annotations into local Markdown notes
The plugin uses a companion CLI, absync, to read local Apple Books data

summary: Syncs Apple Books highlights, notes, and PDF annotations into local Markdown notes using the companion absync CLI.
